description:
General Information
New in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Battery Fusible Link for the Suzuki Samurai 80™ thru 95™
It comes with both sides of the connection so you don’t have to worry about mating it to a particular type of connector.
Protects the Electrical System from Power Surges coming from the Battery like might take place when you are Jump Starting with another vehicle and the cables accidentally touch & spark. This can fry an unprotected wiring harness but is protected if you have this Fusible Link installed.
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Fusible Link
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
